definition.simple: An indicator that reacts only after price has already moved, because it is built from past prices.
definition.balanced: All averages lag. A longer period gives a smoother line but more lag. A shorter period reacts faster but changes direction more often for no lasting reason, which gives more false signals.

example: A 5-period average of closes at 1.1010, 1.1020, 1.1030, 1.1040 and 1.1100 is 1.1040, which is 60 pips below the last close.
